variant: Tiago EV Creative Plus 24 Long Range
pros: New-driver friendly: Height adjustable seats and super gentle throttle modulation make it easy to drive.
Comfortable ride: Rides well over bad roads and feels stable at high speeds.
Looks and feels premium: Contemporary looks and material choices inside make it feel more expensive than it is.
Impressive features: 10.25-inch infotainment, 360-degree camera, auto AC with rear AC vents and many other functional features are impressive for a budget car.
Battery warranty: Bigger battery gets a 15 year warranty which offers peace of mind.
cons: Boot space: Limited space in the boot is only enough for two cabin sized trolleys and a laptop bag.
No paddle shifters: Regenerative mode has to be changed via the buttons on the central console which doesn’t feel intuitive.
Fit and finish: Panel gaps and inconsistent plastic panels take away from the premium experience.

pros: New driver friendly: Height adjustable driver seat with tilt steering adjust and 360-degree camera help make new drivers feel confident
Good entertainment package: 10.25-inch touchscreen has wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, and is paired to an 8-speaker sound system
Features like keyless entry with push-button start stop and automatic AC, ORVMs, and rain sensing wipers add to the convenience factor
Wide opening doors and neutral seat height makes for convenient ingress and egress
Boot space: 419-litres of storage is massive. Even CNG variants get a usable boot with dual cylinder layout
Powertrains: Option of automatic transmission with the CNG kit is great for people who want efficiency without the need of driving a manual
cons: Space: Offers less cabin space as compared to direct rivals
AMT transmission isn’t as refined as its rivals: slow downshifts and feels jerky when driving quickly

pros: Comfortable ride quality: soaks up undulations and speed breakers really well
Usable range: 170-220 km of realistic range makes it a solid city commuter
City performance: Electric performance offers immediate acceleration and quick overtakes in the city
8-speaker sound system offers a good music experience
Covers all functional equipment: Electric ORVMs, cruise control, power windows, and auto AC
cons: Silly feature omissions: alloy wheels, rear AC vents, rear-adjustable headrests
Only packs dual airbags, even in the top-spec variant
Paddle shifters for changing regen modes would be more intuitive than using the button on the dashboard
Looks: Both exterior and interior have started to feel dated. Limited (3) exterior colour options don’t help its case either
Range / battery percentage read-outs could’ve been calibrated for more accuracy
Outdated infotainment package: 7-inch touchscreen feels old to use with slow response times and wired Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connectivity

City performance: Electric performance offers immediate acceleration and quick overtakes in the city
8-speaker sound system offers a good music experience
Covers all functional equipment: Electric ORVMs, cruise control, power windows, and auto AC
cons: Silly feature omissions: alloy wheels, rear AC vents, rear-adjustable headrests
Only packs dual airbags, even in the top-spec variant
Paddle shifters for changing regen modes would be more intuitive than using the button on the dashboard
Looks: Both exterior and interior have started to feel dated. Limited (3) exterior colour options don’t help its case either
Range / battery percentage read-outs could’ve been calibrated for more accuracy
Outdated infotainment package: 7-inch touchscreen feels old to use with slow response times and wired Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connectivity

pros: Spacious cabin: There is more than enough space for a family of 4 to sit comfortably
Good features: 9-inch infotainment, a 360-degree camera, and a heads-up display
Smooth performance: The 1.2-litre petrol engine offers a refined and enjoyable drive experience
Keeps you comfortable: The ride quality limits unnecessary movement and keeps the car stable over bad roads
Premium quality: Well built on the inside and out. Fitment quality feels good
cons: Needs distinctive identity: Looks a lot like the Maruti Baleno and there is not a lot of styling changes
Soft seat cushioning: During long drives, the soft cushioning can cause fatigue in the back
Needs a proper automatic: The AMT is good but it is not as smooth and sophisticated as a CVT or a DCT

pros: Effortless engine: The proven 2.8-litre diesel is torquey and relaxed, now paired with a smoother, more polished automatic.
Big cabin upgrade: A completely redesigned, chunky dashboard and a far more comfortable, big-person-friendly driving position.
Improved ride comfort: Toyota has taken a good amount of sharpness out of the ride, most noticeably in the front row.
Serious off-road hardware: Ladder-frame chassis, low-range 4x4, rear diff lock and a full suite of traction electronics.
Modern, imposing design: The redesigned face and brawnier stance look fresher and more aggressive without losing the Hilux's tough character.
cons: Under-equipped for the price: Manual AC, a manual-dimming mirror, fabric seats and no ADAS on a truck costing around Rs 35-40 lakh on-road.
Compromised rear seat: An upright, non-reclining backrest, a high floor and no rear AC vents make the back bench a poor place for family.
Still firm over big hits: Sharp speed breakers and deep potholes still send a strong jolt through the cabin.
Bulky in the city: Heavy low-speed steering and a 5,325 mm length make tight traffic and parking a chore.

pros: Reliable family car: Comes with Toyota’s reliable and future proof engineering
Practical cabin: Offers great storage spaces, AC vents in all three rows, and rear cupholders
Necessary equipment: Gets all the required features like auto AC and a touchscreen that you’ll need for your daily drives
Great space: It is one of the most spacious MPVs for the price, which offers good space for 7 adults
Capable powertrain: Comes with a powerful and efficient diesel engine with a rear-wheel-drive setup
cons: The ride quality feels a little jumpy when driving with low load
A little too expensive: Prices have gone up since its introduction and feel high for the feature list on offer
Less powertrain options: Misses out on a petrol engine and an automatic powertrain

pros: Spacious cabin: There is enough space in the cabin to seat 6 adults comfortable
No compromise on features: You get ADAS, ventilated seats, a panoramic sunroof and a good infotainment system in the top-spec variant
Focus on practicality: It comes with plenty of storage spaces and a big enough boot to keep all your luggage and items

Lounge-like experience: The ottoman function in the second row adds a lot of comfort to your chauffeur-driven experience
cons: Hefty price: Due to its powertrain, the prices crosses the Rs 30 lakh mark, which seems high for the features on offer
Inconsistent cabin quality: There are some places in the cabin with hard plastics which do not match the quality of the rest of the cabin
